codexStages.observed: Green anaconda. Twenty-plus feet of constrictor that hunts like the river itself — patient, submerged, inevitable. The System admires the efficiency and is taking notes.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Death Coil (ambush grapple from water, constricts each turn), Withdraw (below 25% it releases). It kills by wrapping, not biting. When the coils start, strike the head and eyes — it releases to protect them. Never let it get a second wrap. Meat: a feast. The hide is legendary.
codexStages.unknown: Something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log.

counter.hint: It kills by wrapping, not biting. It hates having its head touched — the head is the whole animal's pride.
counter.reveal: When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. On land it is slow and heavy; it needs the water to be the Empress. Never let it get a second wrap.

warn: The water bulges. A ripple with intent — and then the coils move. This is the warning.

encounter.comment: Anaconda Empress: lurk->bulge->coil. Ambush grapple from water tiles; head strikes break the coil. Slow on land.

codexStages.observed: Warthog. The System watched it graze on its knees and decided the meek part was a lie. It charges through its own dust wall — tusks, hooves, and bad intentions. It cannot turn mid-charge.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Dust-Choked Charge (heavy, telegraphed, a wall of blinding dust ahead of it), Tusk Rake (close range, sideways sweep), Retreat (below 25% hp). It never goes around — step OFF the lane and hold your breath until the dust settles. Meat: excellent pork. The tusks make fine awls.
codexStages.unknown: Something heavy moved in the grass. Then the dust stood up and walked toward you.

counter.hint: It never turns. The charge is a straight-line promise, and the dust is just weather.
counter.reveal: When it paws the earth, step OFF the lane — sideways, not back — and cover your mouth. The dust blinds it too; it charges where you WERE. Wait for the cough, then strike.
counter.trick: Step OFF the lane — and hold your breath

warn: It drops its head. Paws the earth. Dust rises. This is the warning. There won't be another.

codexStages.observed: Nile monitor. The System grew mirror-scales along its back and taught it to aim the sun. It blinds you with reflected light, then lunges while you can't see. The tail is a separate weapon — thick as your leg.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Sunflash Lunge (blinding telegraph, then a fast lunge at your last position), Tail Sweep (close range, knockdown), Retreat (below 25% hp). The glare needs the sun behind IT — fight from its shadow side, or make it face away from the sun. Never stand where you were standing.
codexStages.unknown: A flash of light from the grass, like a mirror catching the sun. Then nothing. Then the flash again, closer.

counter.hint: The glare needs the sun behind it. Its shadow side is blind.
counter.reveal: When it arches, move to its SHADOW side — between it and the sun — and don't stand still. The lunge goes where you WERE, and the glare can't touch you from the shade. Strike while it's recharging the scales.

warn: It arches its back to the sun. The light off its scales hurts to look at. Move.
wary: It circles, keeping the sun at its back. It knows what its weapon needs.

edible.note: Tough reptile meat — stew it long. The mirror-scales flake off; they're pretty and useless.

codexStages.slain: Moves: Sanjun's Pounce (charge, telegraphed by the crouch — the lane locks early), Raking Claws (close range), Withdraw (below 25% hp). It never chases what stands its ground and shouts — the chase instinct needs a runner. Meat: a tiger feeds the village for a week. The pelt is beyond price.
codexStages.unknown: The bamboo went still in a way that had nothing to do with wind. Then the stripes resolved.

counter.hint: Running wakes the chase in it. It has eaten everything that ever ran.
counter.reveal: When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched.

codexStages.observed: A raccoon dog. The System found tanuki folklore — the belly-drumming shapeshifter — and decided the folklore was understating things. The belly is a drum, the drum is a weapon, and the waddle is a lie: it is exactly where it means to be.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Belly-Drum Thunderclap (burst sonic, telegraphed by the swelling belly — strike the taut drum during the inhale and the shockwave backfires), Trickster's Feint (repositioning nip). It can't chase; it waddles. Keep your ears on the drum, not your eyes on the waddle. Meat: fatty and dark.
codexStages.unknown: BOOM. Out of the dark, a drumbeat with no drummer. Then another, closer.

counter.hint: The drum must swell before it sounds. The inhale is the tell.
counter.reveal: When the belly swells drum-taut, STRIKE — the stretched skin is thin as a drumhead and the thunderclap backfires, stunning it senseless. Hit the drum, not the drummer.

warn: It rears up. The belly starts to swell. You know what comes next.
